mapper.sql: SELECT biz01_promo.* , biz90_limit.* , biz02_cnt.* , TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / (CASE WHEN biz01_provide_rcv_type = '2' THEN f_nvl(biz02_emp_count,1) ELSE f_nvl(biz02_count ,1) END)) AS biz01_average_price , TRUNC(biz01_provide_amt / f_nvl(biz01_peple_count,1)) AS biz01_average_price2 FROM biz01_promo INNER JOIN biz90_limit ON ( biz90_company_id = biz01_company_id AND biz90_provide_rcv_type = biz01_provide_rcv_type AND biz90_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(biz90_start_date) FROM biz90_limit WHERE biz90_company_id = biz01_company_id AND biz90_provide_rcv_type = biz01_provide_rcv_type AND biz90_start_date <= biz01_provide_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS biz02_count , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS biz02_emp_count FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id ) biz02_cnt ON TRUE WHERE biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz01_provide_rcv_type like #{provideRcvType} AND to_char(biz01_provide_date,'yyyy') = #{yearText} AND SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,1,1) in ('1','2') /* 10:판매(일반)/11:판매(경조)/20:운용(일반)/21:운용(경조)/50:관리(일반) */

sql.if: AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit1 /* 일반 */ ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit2 END) /* 경조 */
